verdict.rationale: Circle publishes an API reference section (api-reference.md, webhooks reference) and machine-readable OpenAPI specs (compliance.yaml, gateway.yaml), which form the basis of an explorable reference. Nothing in the pack shows that the reference is interactive or that it offers runnable examples, and standard OpenAPI discovery paths return 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive 'try it' or API explorer, runnable code examples, sandbox execution from the docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
